name: Hunza Valley
subtitle: Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan
intro:
Hunza was a princely state, bordering China to the north-east and Pamir to its north-west, which continued to survive until 1974, when it was finally dissolved by Zulfikar Ali Bhutto. The state bordered the Gilgit Agency to the south, the former princely state of Nagar to the east. The state capital was the town of Baltit and its old settlement is Ganish Village.
